request: Who has access to the billing mailbox?
final_text:
The billing mailbox (billing@harborpointdental.test) is a shared mailbox. Currently, the following people have access:

**Full Access (can read and manage emails):**
- Omar Haddad (omar.haddad@harborpointdental.test)
- Julia Park (julia.park@harborpointdental.test)

**Send As permission (can send emails appearing to come from the billing mailbox):**  
*No one currently has this permission.*

**Send on Behalf permission (can send emails on behalf of the billing mailbox):**
